summary: Implementation dispatch (session sess_1784065982_0f4e12) landed Phases 1-7 of the 11-phase plan, fully verified, sorry-free, each committed separately. This is the plan's designated 'last guaranteed-green point': cs5FC''_cs5Mreach : cs5FC'' (@cs5Mreach Atom) is proved, meaning soundness over cs5FC'' for all 17 CS5 axioms AND full canonical frame-condition verification are both done. Phases 1-3 retired task 508's refuted negative verdict and documented the CS5==IS5 collapse. Phases 4-7 built the symmetric-tail canonical model end to end: list-splitting/bigAnd helpers (Phase 4), cs5Tail with definitional symmetry (Phase 5), cs5_diam_witness (Phase 6), and canonical FCsym_box/FC4' (Phase 7). Two real bugs were found and fixed during implementation (not present in the verified probes, both documented in commit messages and the plan file): (1) a Derivable/Nonempty value cannot be destructured inside a Type-valued nested tactic block (Phase 2's cs5_dia_or); (2) cs5_fc4_theory's raw conclusion 'exists v, w subset v and t in cs5Tail v' does not give QuasiPrime v (the tail-membership fact gives QuasiPrime of the FIXED t, not the fresh witness v) -- required explicitly returning QuasiPrime v alongside. A third finding: the report's four-step DerivExcludes discharge sketch omits an exploding-head (bot in H) case split needed in all three prime_set_exclusion instantiations (Phases 6 and 7 twice) -- boxInv(Set.univ)=Set.univ makes the naive exclusion base inconsistent when the head explodes; handled with the exploding segment as a direct trivial witness in each case. Phases 8-10 (the box-backward pair construction, the plan's sole genuinely open research risk) and Phase 11 (assembly or Branch B fallback) were NOT attempted in this dispatch -- stopped cleanly at the Phase 7/8 boundary given phases 8-10's explicit highest-risk status and the context budget already spent on phases 1-7's substantial proof engineering. A separate concurrent plan-revision (visible in this file's prior version, preserved in decisions_made/dead_ends below) has already reframed Phase 8-10's design: reuse prime_set_exclusion/set_maximal_is_prime directly via a DESIGNATED-FORMULA exclusion invariant, not a bot-exclusion poset and not a novel primeness lemma -- a fresh agent resuming Phase 8 should follow that revised design, not this dispatch's original Phase-8 task text.

blockers.description: Truth lemma box-backward case for the symmetric-tail CS5 canonical model (Phases 8-10, not yet attempted). Requires: given prime H with box-A not in H, build prime H' superset H and prime T SIMULTANEOUSLY with boxInv H' subset T, boxInv T subset H', A not in T, box-A not in H'. Sequential Lindenbaum provably fails (cs5_symmetric_tail_box_gap, landed Phase 5) and the gap is non-vacuous (three-world cs5FC'' countermodel in probes/cs5-boxgap-countermodel.lean). CURRENT DESIGN (per the concurrent plan revision captured in decisions_made below, more authoritative than this dispatch's original Phase 8 task text): build the pair poset around the pre-existing prime_set_exclusion (PrimeExclusion.lean:558) / set_maximal_is_prime (PrimeExclusion.lean:428) with a DESIGNATED-FORMULA exclusion invariant (box-A not in H', A not in T), NOT a bot-exclusion poset -- this reuses the existing primeness engine directly rather than inventing a new one, and avoids Pacheco's W_bot=empty collapse. Fallback (Phase 11 Branch B) is mandatory if this does not close: state the obstruction as a mechanized theorem, never a sorry. Severity soft: Phases 1-7 are a complete, independently valuable, already-landed increment regardless of how Phase 8-10 resolves.

dead_ends: task 508's cs5FCweak: omits plain symmetry, so bDia is unsound over it. bDia_not_valid_over_cs5FCweak is sound but says nothing about cs5FC''. Do not treat it as ruling out the CS4 technique.

Set.univ-free tail redesign via cs5_dia_bot_imp_bot (508's nominated 'one lead'): unnecessary for tail construction. Set.univ-freeness follows from the tail's boxInv t subset H clause, since boxInv Set.univ = Set.univ (cs5Tail_univ_free). Matches Pacheco's Wc-bot = empty. NOTE: cs5_dia_bot_imp_bot itself WAS needed and landed in Phase 6, but for a different purpose than 508 nominated -- discharging the exploding-head case split's contradiction, not for tail redesign.
Deriving canonical symmetry from maximality (508's stated blocker): a non-problem. Symmetry is by construction, so negation-completeness of quasi-prime heads is never needed.

508 section 4(c)'s rejection of simultaneous Lindenbaum exclusion: void twice over. It targets exclusion sets of DIAMONDS, whereas ours are BOXES and (box B or box B') -> box(B or B') is derivable; AND its premise is false for CS5 anyway — cs5_dia_or proves CS5 |- dia(A or B) -> dia A or dia B.
Sequential Lindenbaum for the box-backward case (build H' first, then T): provably fails per cs5_symmetric_tail_box_gap (landed, mechanized, Phase 5). A simultaneous pair construction is required.

Proving box(A or box D) -> box A or D as a route to the box-backward case: not valid over cs5FC'' (mechanized three-world countermodel, probes/cs5-boxgap-countermodel.lean -- not yet landed in the library, deferred to Phase 11 Branch B if needed).

Transcribing Pacheco Lemma 18 / Lemma 16 primeness verbatim: the published argument is unsound (uses negation-completeness). Port the pair-Zorn skeleton only; reprove primeness (or, per the revised design, reuse set_maximal_is_prime directly via designated-formula exclusion).

Choosing between Pacheco's diamond-inverse relation and our box-inverse one: a non-choice. cs5_boxInv_subset_iff proves boxInv T subset H <-> T subset diaInv H over CS5 — they are the same relation. LANDED Phase 2.

Transcribing Pacheco Lemma 18 (or its Lemma 16 primeness step) into any phase: forbidden. It is defective in five ways (unsound negation-completeness primeness; empty poset; cross-conditions miss the tail relation; asserted seed; absent Zorn chain step). Imitate the pair-poset technique only; prove every structural step.

Using a bot-exclusion (perp-not-in-X) invariant for the pair poset: forbidden. It reproduces Pacheco's empty-poset defect and drags in his W_bot=empty collapse. Use designated-formula exclusion (box-A not in H', A not in T), which makes the pre-existing prime_set_exclusion/set_maximal_is_prime supply primeness directly.

Silently landing a CKB/IKB collapse theorem: forbidden. The collapse is documented (Phase 3, landed) and corroborated (k3/k5, landed Phase 2), but CKB<->IKB is not re-proved; any collapse byproduct of the Phase 9 construction (not yet attempted) must be flagged explicitly when Phase 9 is done.
